notes: Site is dark-only; light and dark renders are identical, so counts are per-width (x2) not per-theme.
Gradient text (background-clip:text) is indeterminate for contrast and counted in features.gradientText.
Fixed blurred orbs behind content are ignored when compositing backgrounds.
overlaps=1 (install code vs Copy button) is a range-rect artifact of text-overflow:ellipsis, not a real overlap.
elementsBeyondViewport are the decorative fixed orbs (body has overflow-x hidden).
Corrected 2026-10-06: clipped-text check no longer counts cells inside a deliberate overflow-x scroller (first run over-reported 26 at 390).
